column1: # Values the Rust here must agree on with the code it links, one per line:
# the module and the `def` in it, which must be `def <name>: Nat =
# <numeral>;` and is what the linked code itself uses. `generated/constants.rs`
# is the Rust of them, written by `scripts/linked` (`heather linked-exports`,
# `heather_cli::linked::constants_rs`) and held to the modules by
# `crates/cli/tests/linked_exports.rs`, so none is written by hand in Rust.
